title: Marin Learn v1
description: Normative JSON Schema for Marin Learn v1 learning packages. The canonical structured metadata is stored as one JSON-LD-style @graph. Narrative ContentUnit bodies are stored as external Markdown files and binary/static media are stored as package assets.

@context.description: Schema.org plus the Marin Learn namespace.

@graph.description: Exactly one LearningSet plus all other package objects.

x-marin-validation: All @id values must be unique package-wide.
All identifier values must be unique within their object category.
Every internal @id reference must resolve to exactly one graph object.
Reference target types must match the relationship documented by the property.
marin:parentObjective relationships must be acyclic.
Nested marin:Section depth must not exceed 3 rendered section levels.
Grade-band minPercent values must not repeat.
For multiple-select items, not every ResponseOption may be correct.
For true-false items, the two referenced ResponseOptions must use identifiers true and false.
For Slide ListItems using marin:displayMode abstract, the referenced ContentUnit must define abstract.
Files referenced by contentUrl must exist inside the package and must not escape the package root.
Markdown content must conform to the normative Marin Learn Markdown profile.

uuidUrn.description: Stable UUID URN. UUID version is not restricted by Marin Learn v1.

identifier.description: Human-readable lowercase slug used for authoring, debugging, and filenames where appropriate.

languageTag.description: BCP 47-style language tag, such as en-US.

markdown.description: Marin Learn Markdown. Must conform to the separately defined Marin Learn Markdown profile: CommonMark/GFM-style paragraphs, emphasis, strong emphasis, links, lists, relative headings, block quotations, fenced code, simple tables, and images; raw HTML and executable content are prohibited.

safeContentPath.description: Relative package path under content/ ending in .md and containing no dot-segments.

safeAssetPath.description: Relative package path under assets/ containing no dot-segments.

externalThing.description: Inline Schema.org-compatible external object. Unknown Schema.org properties are permitted here.

x-marin-validation: ListItem.position values must begin at 1, be unique, and be contiguous. Array order is not authoritative.
Every item reference must resolve to marin:AssessmentItem.
ListItem.position values must begin at 1, be unique, and be contiguous.
Every item reference must resolve to marin:ResponseOption.
ListItem.position values must begin at 1, be unique, and be contiguous.
Every item reference must resolve to marin:ContentUnit.
If marin:displayMode is abstract, the referenced ContentUnit must define abstract.
ListItem.position values must begin at 1, be unique, and be contiguous.
For mode random, count must not exceed the number of AssessmentItems in marin:itemSequence.

scoringPolicy.description: Weighted-sum score = earned selected-item weight / maximum selected-item weight * 100. A missing ListItem marin:weight is treated as 1.
x-marin-validation: gradeScale, when present, must resolve to marin:GradeScale.

x-marin-reference.notes: Marin Learn uses a custom LearningSet subtype because a package is not necessarily a formal Course.

x-marin-validation: marin:startResource, when present, must resolve to marin:LearningMaterial, marin:Assessment, or marin:Presentation.
inLanguage is inherited by contained resources when they omit it.
audience, educationalLevel, license, and publisher may also act as Marin Learn package defaults when omitted by contained resources.
Each hasDefinedTerm reference must resolve to a DefinedTerm learning objective.
inDefinedTermSet must resolve to a DefinedTermSet.
marin:parentObjective, when present, must resolve to another learning objective and must not create a cycle.

informedBy.concept: topic as basic unit of authoring and reuse
reusable learning content associated with objectives

x-marin-ux.abstract: Recommended, not required. The editor should explain that abstracts are often used as concise presentation-slide content and for browsing/search summaries.

x-marin-validation: The referenced Markdown file must exist and conform to the Marin Learn Markdown profile.
teaches is optional; when present, each reference must resolve to a learning objective.
Each marin:contentSequence item must resolve to marin:ContentUnit or marin:Section.
Aggregate teaches relationships should normally be derived from referenced ContentUnits rather than redundantly persisted.
Each marin:contentSequence item must resolve to marin:ContentUnit or marin:Section.
Section references must be acyclic.
Rendered Section nesting depth must not exceed 3 levels.
A Section normally has no independent narrative body; its name generates the structural heading.

x-marin-reference.notes: Schema.org Quiz is intentionally not used because it is not an active core type suitable for normative assessment semantics.

x-marin-validation: Every marin:itemSequence reference must resolve to marin:AssessmentItem.
For random selection, count must not exceed the number of available items.
Effective assesses relationships may be derived from referenced AssessmentItems.

x-marin-reference.notes: Schema.org Question is intentionally not used because acceptedAnswer/suggestedAnswer model Q&A content rather than assessment response processing.

x-marin-validation: Every marin:options reference must resolve to a marin:ResponseOption.
Every marin:correctResponse reference must resolve to an option belonging to this AssessmentItem.
For multiple-select, not every option may be correct.
For true-false, the two ResponseOptions must use identifiers true and false.
assesses, when present, must resolve to learning objectives.
isBasedOn, when used for internal instructional sourcing, should resolve to ContentUnits containing sufficient material to answer the item.

x-marin-reference.notes: Correctness is not stored on ResponseOption. marin:correctResponse on AssessmentItem is the sole source of truth.

x-marin-validation: minPercent thresholds must be unique.
The applicable band is the band with the greatest minPercent less than or equal to the score.
If the scale is intended to cover all scores, at least one band must begin at 0.
Every marin:slideSequence item must resolve to marin:Slide.
isBasedOn should normally reference the LearningMaterial from which the presentation is derived.
Effective teaches relationships may be derived from referenced ContentUnits.
Each marin:contentSequence item must resolve to a ContentUnit.
Speaker notes use the full Marin Learn Markdown profile.
A title slide may omit marin:contentSequence.
Alternative text is contextual and must be stored in the Markdown image usage, not globally on the ImageObject.
An empty Markdown alt value is valid only after the editor explicitly records the image use as decorative by the serialization rules.
